notes.title: Rave From Your Grave!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone

It's been a while, too long. These last few years have been hard on all of us, the pandemic ran its course and not only did the virus itself cause tremendous suffering, but the lock down and destruction of social connections really caused a lot of mental damage. I definitely struggled with depression, and along with a bad case of burnout and some ineffective medication, it left me in a place where I just couldn't carry on development. I also struggled a lot with communication and unfortunately I let things slip. For that I truly apologise.

One thing I hate more than anything is leaving something unfinished, and things have begun to improve for me to the point that I can now restart development. There's still a lot to do: I have at least 3 more Wak-bot stages to complete, more attacks, a bunch of online/community components and a whole lot of polish and tuning to complete. I still believe in this project, and when it's all put together I think it will be a great experience.

Development will start slowly, I have a day job and that's going well so it has to take priority, but you will start seeing new additions to the game very soon.

TL,DR: I'm sorry, I'm back, things will develop slowly but updates are on the way!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.19.1
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone Hotfix 0.19.1 is here!

This update reduces the games overall storage footprint by almost 1 gigabyte!

There are also several quality of life updates and some behind the scenes changes to the game structure to prepare for our first background stage Moon Base 2!

November has been a slow month, but It's looking like I'll be able to ramp up again soon. Stay tuned for a brand new stage, new customization options, and soon a new Wak-bot with some very unique challenges!

notes.title: Update 0.19
notes.notes:
[b]Update 0.19 is here![/b]

Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Added Ice attack upgrades, and fire attack upgrades! Level up any Special attack to level 6 or above to purchase the Fire or Ice attack upgrades. 

Fire attacks apply the Burn status to the Wak-Bot and trigger 3 quick explosions which keep the Wak-bot airborne. This can be great to help lock the Wak-Bot in place to deliver more attacks!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Xb6hIk4RbikrN6GXwz/giphy.gif[/img]

Ice attacks apply the Frozen status to the Wak-Bot. For a short time the Wak-bot will fall faster, but will then shatter causing a large vertical knockback. The trick to this upgrade is to use other attacks to hold the Wak-bot in place until the shatter occurs!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hQoHHUhfvucwvRg8Y9/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Added 'New' tags to ability upgrades when they are first unlocked. Tags for move upgrades/new moves is on the way.
[/list]

Updates have slowed down a bit with life and COVID getting in the way, but I'm still making steady progress. Vanilla 0.19 is only the beginning of this new push. 0.19 will start with Ice & Fire attacks, but there is much more on the way including additional customization options (color changing finally!), more QOL improvements for the UI, and a brand new background stage!

Come hang out and discuss on the discord: discord.gg/rrNaEN4

Thanks for supporting Aerial Raver!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.2
notes.notes:
It's been a little bit but I have a few new fixes I think you'll like. The first is a fix for a bug that has been bothering me for a while, sometimes in a chaotic combo you would press the buttons for super 2 and super 1 would come out. This should no longer happen!

Also added the ability to bring up the combo end menu before you do a combo, in case you need to upgrade or change your moves. You can now just press Start/Options at anytime to bring up the menu.
 
And I've added a setting that was requested by an early access player, the ability to increase the hitStop within the game.

The full tutorial is almost ready, I am just going to spend one more day recording some example video's that will help explain some of the more difficult concepts. Expect that sometime next week and then it's on to version 0.19!

[b]Aerial Raver Hotfix 0.18.2
[/b]
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Removed a bug that would cause the incorrect super to be activated when used.
[*] Added the ability to access the combo ending menu before launching the Wak-bot. Just hit the Start or Options button on your controller before you launch.
[*] Added an Extra HitStop option to the settings menu. This adds extra pause to the game when your attack hits. You can set this to a setting that feels right for you.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fvSUkFhLIXmnRWs6xC/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]

Thanks for supporting Aerial Raver!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.1
notes.notes:
A few new fixes going in today. I found an exploit right before launch that could lead to using mulit-hit moves infinitely. To quickly fix the issue I ended up making multi-hit moves weaker than I would have wanted until I could get this proper fix in. 

Also I've been wanting to get this mission shortcut in for a while so you can quickly move to another mission once you complete the current one.

Still working on fleshing out the tutorial and a few extra quality of life features before I move on to 0.19.

[b]Aerial Raver Hotfix 0.18.1
[/b]
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Multi-hitting moves will now lose durability properly and not break as quickly.
[*] Re-added Infinite mode activation animation and made infinite mode able to cancel attacks.
[*] Added a shortcut to pick a new mission on mission completion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973191/5af17129ff560445278befbce862de39ee863571.png[/img]
[/list]

Thanks for supporting Aerial Raver!
